object.description: Setup: build with a valid map key, device with internet access and location permission. Steps: 1. With a network proxy active, select Terrain, then Minimal, then Satellite in Settings. 2. After each change open the Active map view, Summary and Workout Detail. 3. Read the style requests. Expected: Each screen shows the selected style. The style requests go to api.maptiler.com with the map ids outdoor-v2, dataviz-dark and hybrid for Terrain, Minimal and Satellite respectively.
